<ic>That the museum in Tabernacle (of Riverwatch, Reikos) has been destroyed in the recent fighting, that it be rebuilt in the lands of Bastion.<br>A museum for the storage and display of Imperial relics and artefacts.<br>Proposer is willing to self fund, but would like to ask the senate and the senators for contributions.<br><br>Proposed by Bastion, seconded by Necropolis.</ic>

===Overview===
* Construct an Imperial museum in [[Bastion]].
* Passed at 8 Thrones

===Date===
* Summer 378YE

===Cost===
* 10 wains of white granite

===Progress===
* 10 wains of white granite supplied by Jada of Highguard after Winter Solstice 378YE.

===Campaign Outcome===
* The [[Curator of the White City Museum]] title was created.
